## Context / Problem
Three finished rollouts still keep their switches in production code. `REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE` (`create_route.py:56-80`, consumed by `batch_dispatch.route_for` `:238-263`, `apply_handlers.py:174-186`, `apply_outbound.py:101-109` and `apply_inbound.py:130-139`; legacy create path `apply_outbound.py:128-175`, `dispatch_one.py:213,363-431`). `REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE` (`reconcile_helpers.py:254-265,304`): landed by epic RP-04 `vibrant-legal-hind` S3 as its AC6 rollback switch; its S7 `junior-lepidolite-boa` checked "legacy facades/switches removed", so deleting it completes S7. `REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP` (readers `apply_handlers.py:268,537,575`) is set to `"1"` in the sole live deployment, `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml:244-246`. Decision: fail-loud becomes unconditional and all three env vars go (no test hook, no injected parameter). Cites are on origin/main d722534cbac.

## Approach
1. Delete `create_route()`, `LEGACY_ROUTE`, `_LEGACY_TOKENS`, `_COORDINATOR_TOKENS` from `create_route.py` (keep `COORDINATOR_ROUTE` and `_coordinated_create_core`). `route_for` returns `COORDINATOR_ROUTE` for create unconditionally and stops importing the selector; `batch_dispatch.LEGACY_ROUTE` stays for the non-create families it already routes. `apply_handlers` always uses `_coordinated_create_core`. `apply_inbound._apply_inbound_create` drops the `create_route()` call and the `create_route` key of its `ApplyResult` payload (observability only; no reader). `apply_outbound._apply_outbound_create` (`:101-109`) drops its `create_route`/`LEGACY_ROUTE` import and legacy branch and calls `run_coordinated_outbound_create` unconditionally. Delete `_apply_outbound_create_legacy`, `_legacy_create_core`, `_legacy_record_key` and the `create_core or _legacy_create_core` fallback (`dispatch_one.py:213`; `create_core` becomes required).
2. Delete `_write_facade_enabled` and its `if not ...: return` guard: `bind_operation_runtime` always composes; fix the `reconcile.py:112` comment. `applier._load_acli` (the client fallback `apply()` uses when called without one; 25 test modules patch it) is NOT a toggle and stays.
3. Make the three fail-loud branches unconditional; delete the env reads and `reconcile-bridge.yml:244-246`; delete the toggle paragraphs in `docs/config.md:385-395` and `docs/jira-sync-setup.md:453-465` (rollback section keeps only pause and re-validate); regenerate `docs/env-vars.md`; reword the `apply_planning.py:233` comment; add the BREAKING entries to `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/release-notes.md`.
4. Baseline: the three `env_var` rows in `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` and the `_force_legacy_route` autouse fixture go stale; `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py` requires baseline == tree, so run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in the same change (operator-sanctioned on the epic; stated in the commit message).
5. Tests. Delete `tests/unit/reconciler/mutate/test_apply_outbound_create_rollback.py`. Delete the legacy-route cases: `test_create_operation_coordinator.py::test_create_route_selector_default_and_rollback`, `test_create_live_cutover_heldout.py::test_legacy_route_runs_legacy_core_byte_identical` and the `legacy` parameter of its both-routes tests, the `legacy` parameter of `test_coordinator_route_census.py::test_ac6_no_remote_delete_on_any_create_route` and its `test_ac3_legacy_create_core_unreachable_from_production` (the core is deleted), the legacy branch of `test_reconciler_coordinator_taxonomy.py::test_s7_...`, the `REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE=legacy` leg of `orchestrate/test_leaves_effect_matrix.py:137-171`; `orchestrate/test_reconcile_filter.py:454-545` (the `_load_create_route` helper and its route-selection tests) asserts `route_for("create")` instead of calling `create_route()`. Rewrite `apply/test_silent_noop_canary.py`, `apply/test_fail_loud_comment_errors.py` and `test_live_mode_failure_tally.py` to assert unconditional hard-fail with no env set. `test_reconciler_documentation_contracts_6262.py:67-86` stops asserting the deleted names and instead asserts `docs/jira-sync-setup.md` and `docs/env-vars.md` do not name them. Update the `test_outbound_link_failure_accounting.py:24` docstring. `test_internal_shim_removal.py` (asserts `_write_facade_enabled` absent from `reconcile`) is unchanged.
Rollback: one commit; `git revert` restores the three toggles and the legacy create path together.

BREAKING: env vars `REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE`, `REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE`, `REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP` removed; silent sub-op no-ops and swallowed comment failures always fail the mutation; CREATE always takes the coordinated write-ahead path.

## Scope
`src/rebar/reconciler/{create_route,batch_dispatch,apply_handlers,apply_inbound,apply_outbound,dispatch_one,reconcile_helpers,reconcile,apply_planning}.py`, `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`, `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`, `docs/config.md`, `docs/jira-sync-setup.md`, `docs/env-vars.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, the tests named in step 5 (all under `tests/unit/reconciler/`). Out of scope: `applier._load_acli`, `fetcher._load_acli`, `MODE_CAPS` and the bootstrap modes, every other `REBAR_RECONCILER_*` variable.

## Testing
`pytest tests/unit/reconciler -q`; `make verify`. Edge: `REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE=legacy pytest tests/unit/reconciler/mutate/test_create_live_cutover_heldout.py` behaves identically (env ignored); a `comment_errors`-carrying outcome with no env set has `outcome["error"]` starting `comment-errors:`; `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` clean; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` shows `increased=0` and no unadmitted new key.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `git grep -nE 'REBAR_RECONCILER_(CREATE_ROUTE|WRITE_FACADE|FAIL_SILENT_NOOP)' -- src .github docs tests` matches only `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, and the absence assertions in `test_reconciler_documentation_contracts_6262.py`.
- [x] `git grep -nE 'def (create_route|_apply_outbound_create_legacy|_legacy_create_core|_legacy_record_key|_write_facade_enabled)\b' -- src` prints nothing.
- [x] `route_for("create")` is `"coordinator"` with the env set to `legacy` (unit test).
- [x] Silent-no-op and swallowed comment failures count toward `mutation_failures` with no env set (canary tests).
- [x] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` shows `increased=0` and no unadmitted new key.
- [x] `make verify` exits 0.
